scenes.description: An adult energetically working at a packing table, briskly preparing plain cardboard boxes with sleeves rolled up and focused enthusiasm. Dynamic purposeful movement, no shipping labels or writing.
Two hands pull a broad blank sheet apart, opening a long ragged tear between stiff bent edges.
A person bites a large rice cracker with a broken brittle edge and crumbs falling onto a plate.
A white shirt hangs neatly while a hand lifts one sleeve sideways, its cuff hanging downward.
A compact enclosed motor vibrates on a workbench while a person wearing hearing protection stands nearby.
